message.reasoning_content: The kernel omits the ReLU residual. Need to check whether the residual max is bounded so error ≤ 1.0 for all legal x. Compute worst-case sum c_j*relu(...) over the box. Since c=0.25 each, residual contribution = 0.25*sum relu. Need max over x in [-1,1]^12 of sum relu(dot(W,x)-b). This is a maximization of a convex function over a box — max at vertices. Enumerate 2^12 vertices = 4096, cheap. Record claim, run probe.
